notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Version 1.0.1 is now available!
This update focuses on resolving several bugs reported by players and improving the overall game experience. We've polished areas that needed attention, ensured better stability, and added some minor tweaks to make your adventure smoother.[/p][p]Your feedback has been incredibly valuable — thank you for helping us make the game better with every step![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685022/472f46e71c6d1a31b72995899b532540ada207c0.png"][/img][/p]
